notes.title: Details about new update coming to full version of Prison Simulator!
notes.notes:
Players and Officers! New important informations about full version of Prison Simulator !

Hello and welcome to the devlog about our new mode we are adding in Prison Simualtor!!
We are working now on several things right now and one of it is a absolutely new mode in Prison Simulator! This new mode will be distributed for free ! 

Last Man Standing - what are the rules?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/4768ae54be6d512a6500c84b19b06412de24be9b.gif

The rules is simple - get out of prison alive !! The vile riot is destroying prison facility. You have no other choice but to escape ! (it's funny that the guard must escape prison, right?)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/97843b0c3248075f4a2d63364312878868e6375e.gif

This mode is actually action-oriented. We know that you liked a Riot Event from full game a lot ;) so we added some more action in prison for fans ;)

Getting started

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c4838c3406dbde0b3bfdbaafe439a55f6585f700.gif

First you will find yourself without weapons or items in small office...  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/dbf8530693e68a355ec8a6be395dd607d943654c.gif

You got only your trusty fists! Fight your way out! Persuading won't help you this time - prisoners are mad and wants your blood!! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/14c31b852f600897d6b5a223a7cb25f7ffe99c18.gif

Use fists to fight! Remember you can press RMB to defend yourself. But watch a stamina bar !!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/bc142de2c3a6ebf5cd4ee2812c46086ef76218f7.gif

Also you can HOLD an attack button to charge a powerfull PUNCH ! No one can resist that !

This is where a fun begins!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/7d14e81c23e2edf8b54ed8172869e3933615a493.gif

Fortunately in this mess and riot you can still find some usefull items. A riot gun is mandatory, i haven't finished this mode without it ever once :D  
And don't worry about prisoners health - it works on non-lethal bullets !

Stronger enemies

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/b34e4a92cfa13fb1f0888ef1f26c924d3d9cfd09.gif

In one of the updates we added some stronger prisoners to Riot Event. 
Unfortunately they came back for more!! Watch out for mini-bosses with stolen body armor and weapons and also for a tricky ones with GUNS!! Most dangerous ones! You have to defeat them in order to progress through some rooms

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/34cfd1c505fc0b8beae4021e2d3b421d89fa51d9.gif

Entarily new prison!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/45d99ce905fb10090f67e57d06e3322c01866328.gif

We made a entairly new prison for this mode ! It was fun making it ! Hope you won't get lost ;)
After escaping (or after death) you will get a pop up with some informations of how well did you 
did. You know: time passed, prisoners neutralized etc. Try to aim for the best score!

I hope this mode will get you some challenge and fun! It's almost ready to be published, please be patient and wait for some more info about future of Prison Simulator - you won't be dissapointed ;)




Watch our social medias especially Twitter and join our Discord for more behind the scenes footage ;)

Hope you like the prologue. Try full version of Prison Simulator today!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/842180/Prison_Simulator/


Best regards,
Baked Games Team

notes.title: Update and fixes to Prison Simulator full version ! 1.0.4.2v10.11
notes.notes:
Hello dear officers!


We are listening to you - players and we wanna improve our game!
Here is a note about fixed things in Prison Simulator!
If something is not right with your game - feel free to report it to us! 

Changelog to ver. 1.0.4.2v10.11

-Fixed issues that resulted in players being stuck in the locker room at the start of the day 

-The possibility of a riot day after day was blocked 

-Implemented a changes on prisoner's respect after a riot to reduce the frequency of the riots

-Fixed a bug that prevented going to the final event during the Evening Briefing 

-Added a hint about putting the newspaper away

-The entrance to laboratory after finishing story is now blocked  

-Price of selling items for prisoners has been reduced 

-A lot of languages and text errors was fixed, mainly in Chinese translations

-Fixed a bug where the SPRINT and CROUCH buttons bindings were not visible 

-Corrected position of the chairs in newly purchased cells

-Fixed prisoners blocking in visit room

-Fixed guard not showing up at the evening briefing after riots 

-Added auto-setting of texture quality depending on hardware performance 

-Prisoners now have better fighting skills in "defence quest" 


And don't forget about our cool skins for prisoners in previous update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/931550a0900ee21c9e00d4c291ea9aac1c4c32a2.png

Best regards,

notes.title: Prison Simulator gets a Release date! Finally!
notes.notes:
Hello officers! 

We're happy to finally announce that the full version of Prison Simulator is coming to Steam on November 4th, 2021!

In less than a month, you'll be able to:
‧Well... it's a Prison Simulator - so you can simulate the heck out of it (without messing up your life and in the comfort of your own household. Noice, I know)
‧Create your own prisoners with a texture mapping feature 
‧Become a Prison Guard - perform numerous CO's activities, but also you can play some darts or shoot some hoops during your break. AND MORE!
‧Play the Story Mode to uncover the story of the Prison... 
‧..or have fun in Free Play Mode where nothing limits you down

notes.title: Prison Simulator: Catching fire and bug fixes.
notes.notes:
Hello Officers,

Looks like us inmates have found a new way to have fun. Richard caught one of them setting fire to prison property. We're sure it's all to burn us with this building. Be careful out there. This is a warning to remember. Fire is no fun! Fire is to be avoided. 

I am decreeing new rules for our prison! No matches or lighters of any kind, including smokers.

Objection? No problem! If you get burned, you'll stop complaining.

Your best warden.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38933921/fce3f70d155f63c0dc74d49efa2d4fe924e1d0db.png

Our team has been working on the bugs reported by our testers and the Discord server community, and so we've prepared a short list with the most important information for you:

- We fixed the lighting. 
- Added a notification that a player cannot use an item for a specific reason
- Fixed an issue that was causing prisoners' mouths to stick together.
- Improved the way guards find their way around, so they no longer walk into furniture and other items

And more!


We would like to tell you, that we are so proud of you -  our community. Everyday you help us to improve our game. Thank you!

notes.title: Prison Simulator: Prologue - Changes time!
notes.notes:
Hi players,

The end of the week is a great time for news!
Today we come to you with more comparisons of our Prison Simulator: Prologue.

For the past many weeks, our team has been focusing on improving mechanics and general gameplay improvements. During this time, there have been a number of graphical refreshes that have allowed us to make graphical improvements to many rooms.

We improved the look of the guard towers, as the old ones seemed clunky and very unsuited to the environment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38933921/dfeeab0642bac1dadb30247d6fc2b825e4f05ce6.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38933921/3e5d5beba3ef20d719be184494c2d9d995d7ca11.png

The warden's office has also been given a minor makeover. With new furniture, textures and a few decorations, our Grandpa now has a nice little office.

This week is coming to an end, but our work continues. We feel that we are getting closer to giving you a great game in Prison Simulator: Prologue.
